why: A sequence is a walk on the holding count that never goes below 0; count walks of each length that end at targetShares. ways[t][h] = number of length-t sequences ending at holding h, built from ways[t-1][h-1] (buy) and ways[t-1][h+1] (sell), summed over t = 0..maxTransactions.
hints: Only the current holding matters for what comes next. What state would let you count sequences step by step?
State (steps taken, current holding). A buy moves h -> h + 1; a sell moves h -> h - 1 only if h > 0.
Roll a 1-D array over t = 1..maxTransactions, adding ways[target] after every step (and at t = 0). Holdings never exceed start + maxTransactions. O(maxT * (start + maxT)).
pitfalls: Count all lengths 0..maxTransactions, not just length exactly maxTransactions.
A sale is forbidden at 0 shares.
The empty sequence counts only when start == target.
